title: Michelle's Soft Hands
style: warm acoustic ballad, female lead vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft brushed drums, upright bass, gentle string pad, dreamy and proud, 88 bpm, sunny tender feel
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle has the softest hands
Michelle has a quiet plan
Paddle becomes a part of her
Gentle as a feather, sure

[Verse 2]
Third shot drop, soft and slow
Michelle already seems to know
Where the ball is going to land
Gentle Michelle, gentle hand

[Chorus]
Soft hands, soft heart
Michelle is a work of art
Soft hands, sunny day
Michelle was born to play

[Verse 3]
No big swing, no loud sound
Michelle just keeps it on the ground
Sweet little arc, sweet little curve
Michelle has all the nerve

[Chorus]
Soft hands, soft heart
Michelle is a work of art
Soft hands, sunny day
Michelle was born to play

[Bridge]
Bright yellow ball, gentle as a breeze
Michelle plays the game with ease
Like a bee to a flower again
Michelle and her ball, best friends

[Outro]
Soft hands… soft heart…
Michelle… work of art…
